observation.visible_scene: A light wooden tabletop holds a circular mirror with a black rim at center, on which a small metallic object (a disc/top showing a gold face, a silver face, a copper side, and a bright silver band/edge) is spinning and tumbling. To the right, a smartphone in a cylindrical stand displays a running stopwatch (format 00:SS.cc) with a cable plugged into it. Behind the table are patterned cushions and a grey chair back. The camera viewpoint is fixed throughout.
visible_changes: The object on the mirror continuously rotates and tilts, cycling through orientations: gold face upright, edge-on (silver band at top), silver face tilted/upright, copper side angled, then back to gold face upright; this cycle repeats many times across the excerpt.
The phone timer advances steadily from 00:12.12 (first frame) to 00:13.43 (last frame).
The table, mirror, phone, stand, cable, and background remain stationary; only the object's orientation changes.
The mirror surface shows a reflection of the object's underside, distinct from the object itself.
The object's center position on the mirror stays roughly fixed; the change is rotation/tilt (deformation of apparent shape), not translation across the table.
outside_clip_unknowns: How and when the object was set into motion (no onset or stop is visible within the segment).
The object's true identity and material composition beyond its visible faces.
What happens after the excerpt ends or before it began.
The total duration of the spin.
uncertain_details: Whether the object is a spinning top, a flipping coin, or a tumbler; only its changing visible faces are confirmed.
The exact rotation axis and whether the apparent wobble is precession or simple tumbling.
Whether the bright band seen edge-on is the object's rim or a reflected highlight.
